csm.name: Agchem exports: custom synthesis & manufacturing (CSM)
csm.what: Makes patented or proprietary agrochemical active ingredients and intermediates for global innovators under long-term contracts; 25+ global innovator customers; 'top 5 global CSM player' (company). Largest molecule pyroxasulfone (herbicide, Kumiai of Japan).

domestic.name: Domestic agri-brands
domestic.what: Branded crop protection, biologicals and plant nutrition in India, many in-licensed from global innovators (25+ partners); 15,000+ distributors, 1-1.5 lakh retail points, 25 stock points. Brands: Nominee Gold, Biovita, Brofreya, Roket, Pivota; 4 launches in FY26 (3 herbicides, 1 insecticide); 5+ planned for FY27 including PI's own molecule Pioxaniliprole (awaiting registration on 30-Sep-2026).

pharma.name: Pharma: PI Health Sciences (CRDMO)
pharma.what: Contract research, development and manufacturing for pharma/biotech: Archimica (GMP API plant, Lodi, Italy), Therachem (CRO, Hyderabad) and Jaipur. FY26 revenue: CMO Rs 230.6 cr, CRDO Rs 65.9 cr (AR product split).

otherNew.name: New platforms inside 'Agro Chemicals'
otherNew.what: Global biologicals (PI AgSciences, ex-Plant Health Care plc, bought Aug-2024 for Rs 363.9 cr; peptide platform, US$12-13 mn revenue in FY26), electronic and specialty chemicals (target US$80-100 mn revenue in 5-6 years), and PI's own new molecules (NCEs).

Plant Health Care plc (UK, peptide biologicals) acquired for Rs 363.9 cr; renamed PI AgSciences
Promoters move shares into four family trusts (succession), under a SEBI exemption of 14-Aug-2024
